newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lufthansa cargo says should break even.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa cargo says should break even.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo is "on target to break even this year", said Stefan Lauer, a member of the airline's executive board.
Briefing reporters in Hong Kong, Lauer hinted that encouraging results will be revealed at Lufthansa Group's shareholder meeting in Cologne on Thursday.

"I am not able to release the figures before Thursday's meeting but we have a clear target to come close to or break even and everything looks good so far and we are on target to break even," Lauer said.
Last year, Lufthansa Cargo made a pre-tax loss of DM60 million and launched a strategic re-think under the motto: "Thinking in new directions."
Lauer said the modernisation programme appeared to be working and after a good start to the year much depends on how good business is in the second half of the year.

"Lufthansa Cargo has shown a significant improvement over last year. We now have much stronger exports to Germany and have also seen increased traffic between Hong Kong and Europe and strong westbound trade from Europe to the U.S.."

"The improving Mark, the fuel surcharge and increased rates have all contributed to a much better year. The sharp decline in yield has been stopped. If these trends continue Lufthansa Cargo will be able to successfully manage the first phase of its turnround successfully," Lauer added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
